title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The ICSP Programme, implemented by Trócaire in the Bombali, Kambia, Karene, and Port Loko districts of Sierra Leone, contributes to outcome 3.1 Women and older adolescent girls experience increased safety, psychosocial wellbeing, and meaningful participation and leadership. The objective is that women, older adolescent girls and GBV survivors use GBV specialised interventions and psychosocial support to meet their needs and preferences. Activities include awareness raising sessions for communities on the GBV legal framework and referrals; training medical practitioners and others on SGBV survivor centred and inclusive approaches; and the provision of psychosocial support to SGBV survivors. The programme is in partnership with the Rainbo Initiative. ---- The principal focus of this outcome is:Women’s protection and access to specialised GBV supports
